## The question, in plain words

The fix removes the old test that proved a widget always shows its colour. Is that all right?

## The decision, in plain words

Yes: the test checked a screen that no longer exists, and a new one replaces it.

## The options, in plain words

A. Remove the old test, as built.
B. Keep the old test beside the new one.

## What I had to decide

Whether the old proof of the colour law may go.

## What I did meanwhile

Removed the old test.

## What it costs to change later

Restoring one test file.

## What I could not know

(author) Whether the new test covers every case the old one did.
